angular_preflight.interpretation: 38 and 50 points are useful intermediate lanes but are not a defensible universal release reference for sharply non-polynomial angle-frequency kernels.

reasons: The physical n_1s c sigma_T prefactor is now fixed, but the previous conductance must be regenerated rather than globally rescaled.
Lebedev-38/50 do not guarantee isotropy for a sharp non-polynomial angular kernel.
The native/common-measure Kramers-Moyal regression has not yet been rerun with the physically normalized kernel.
